intent: Travel through colour from a country path to dense flowers, rocky hillsides, a lively clearing and an open ridge. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

sections.name: The country flower path
sections.lesson: Low hops follow the flowers. Pass while the thorn head is folded.
